newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-Comerci raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Comerci raised to buy.

text.p: Caspian Research raised its rating on Mexican retailer Controladora Comercial Mexicana (Comerci) to a buy from a market performer rating, the brokerage said in a statement on Friday.
Analysts Esteban Galindez and Damian Fraser said that following the recent correction in the stock's price, Comerci is trading at a sharp discount to fellow retailer Cifra SA .
He said Comerci appears to be taking steps to help margins by scaling back on an aggressive discount pricing strategy.

"Although we recognize that Comerci's strategic position has weakened following the pull-out of Auchan, and its credibility with investors after the Kmart (Corp ) debt-financed purchase has been seriously damaged, we believe the stock market has overreacted," the analyst wrote in the report.
Comerci's B shares were unchanged at 5.76 pesos on the Mexican Stock Market.
